html:
/**
 * @file AdminLogin.js
 * @description <view-admin-login> — the CMS gate: a single Google OAuth
 * sign-in card rendered when the auth listener reports no session.
 * Success flips cms/main.js over to <view-cms-dashboard>; errors surface
 * inline (cancelled popups stay silent — that's a user action, not a
 * failure).
 */

/** @jsx h */
import { CMS_TAGS } from '@cms/tokens.js'
import { FORM_ATTRS } from '@core/tokens/attrs/form.js'
import { ATTR_VALUES } from '@core/tokens/attrs/values.js'
import { AUTH_BLOCKED_STORAGE_CODES, AUTH_STRINGS } from '@core/tokens/strings/auth.js'
import { CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS } from '@core/tokens/data/storage.js'
import { h } from '@core/jsx.js'
import { BaseComponent } from '@core/Component.js'
import { signInWithGoogle } from '@core/firebase.js'
import cmsStyles from '@cms/sass/cms.scss?inline'
import { CMS_ADMIN_CLASSES } from '@cms/tokens.js'
import { devError } from '@core/devlog.js'

/**
 * Unwraps a Firebase error's real cause: auth/internal-error embeds the
 * backend rejection as a JSON string inside `message` (the App-Check 401
 * from createAuthUri), so the inner `error.message` is what actually
 * names the failure. Returns the raw text when it isn't wrapped JSON.
 * @param raw The SDK error message (possibly a JSON-encoded API error).
 * @returns The innermost human-readable message.
 */
const unwrapAuthMessage = (raw: string): string => {
  const start = raw.indexOf('{')

  if (start < 0) return raw

  try {
    const inner = JSON.parse(raw.slice(start)) as { error?: { message?: string } }

    return inner?.error?.message || raw
  } catch {
    return raw
  }
}

/**
 * The ViewAdminLogin — admin login class.
 */
export class ViewAdminLogin extends BaseComponent {
  loading = false // OAuth round-trip in flight — disables the button
  errorMsg: string = ATTR_VALUES.EMPTY // last sign-in error rendered under the button
  private _loginInProgress = false // re-entrancy guard (double-click → duplicate popup error)

  constructor() {
    super(cmsStyles)
  }

  /**
   * Surfaces a broken OAuth round-trip: signInWithGoogle marks the
   * session before the redirect navigation and preserves the popup-leg
   * code; still seeing the marker when this view mounts means the
   * return leg restored no session. The relay stores the event in the
   * helper iframe's web storage, so browsers that partition or block
   * third-party site data drop it — even with first-party cookies
   * allowed. Without this the flow loops silently:
   * click → Google → back → login → repeat.
   */
  override connectedCallback(): void {
    try {
      const authErr = sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_ERROR)
      const popupErr = sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_POPUP_ERROR)
      const popupRaw = sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_POPUP_DETAIL)

      sessionStorage.removeItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_ERROR)
      sessionStorage.removeItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_POPUP_ERROR)
      sessionStorage.removeItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_POPUP_DETAIL)

      const popupCause = popupRaw ? unwrapAuthMessage(popupRaw) : ATTR_VALUES.EMPTY
      const popupDetail = popupErr
        ? ` — earlier popup attempt: ${popupErr}` + (popupCause ? ` (${popupCause})` : '')
        : ''
      const appCheckRejected = popupCause.includes(AUTH_STRINGS.APPCHECK_MARKER)

      if (authErr) {
        this.errorMsg = appCheckRejected
          ? 'Sign-in was rejected by the Firebase project — ' +
            'Authentication enforces App Check but this app sends no ' +
            'App Check token. Configure a reCAPTCHA site key ' +
            '(VITE_FIREBASE_APPCHECK_SITE_KEY) or relax App Check ' +
            'enforcement for Authentication in the Firebase console.'
          : AUTH_BLOCKED_STORAGE_CODES.includes(authErr)
            ? 'Sign-in could not complete — the OAuth session was lost ' +
              `on the return leg (${authErr}${popupDetail}). The auth ` +
              'helper relays sign-in through cross-origin web storage, ' +
              'which browsers partition or block as third-party site ' +
              'data even when first-party cookies are allowed. Use the ' +
              'same-origin CMS entry (https), or allow third-party ' +
              'site data for this page, then try again.'
            : 'Sign-in could not complete — the OAuth return was ' +
              `rejected (${authErr}${popupDetail}). Check the Firebase ` +
              "console's authorized domains and Google provider " +
              'configuration.'
      } else if (sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_REDIRECT)) {
        sessionStorage.removeItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_REDIRECT)

        this.errorMsg = appCheckRejected
          ? 'Sign-in was rejected by the Firebase project — ' +
            'Authentication enforces App Check but this app sends no ' +
            'App Check token. Configure a reCAPTCHA site key ' +
            '(VITE_FIREBASE_APPCHECK_SITE_KEY) or relax App Check ' +
            'enforcement for Authentication in the Firebase console.'
          : 'Sign-in could not complete — the OAuth round-trip ' +
            `returned no session${popupDetail}. The auth helper's ` +
            'cross-origin storage was likely partitioned or blocked; ' +
            'use the same-origin CMS entry (https), or allow ' +
            'third-party site data for this page, then try again.'
      }
    } catch {
      /* sessionStorage itself unavailable — nothing to report */
    }

    super.connectedCallback()
  }

  /**
   * Runs the Firebase Google OAuth popup flow; errors surface in the UI.
   * The button's JSX `onClick` is the single handler — the render pass
   * re-attaches it on every fresh node, so no manual rebind step exists
   * (a second listener would double-fire the popup request).
   */

  async handleGoogleLogin(): Promise<void> {
    // Guard: prevent duplicate popup calls that cause auth/cancelled-popup-request
    if (this._loginInProgress) return
    this._loginInProgress = true
    this.loading = true
    this.errorMsg = ATTR_VALUES.EMPTY
    this._updateDom()

    try {
      await signInWithGoogle()
    } catch (err) {
      // Suppress cancelled-popup noise (user closed the popup)
      const e = err as { code?: string; message?: string }

      if (
        e?.code === AUTH_STRINGS.ERR_CANCELLED_POPUP ||
        e?.code === AUTH_STRINGS.ERR_POPUP_CLOSED
      ) {
        this.errorMsg = ATTR_VALUES.EMPTY
      } else {
        devError('Google Sign-In Error:', err)

        // signInWithGoogle persists the recovered server-side cause
        // (CMS_AUTH_POPUP_DETAIL) — the SDK strips it from the thrown
        // error — so prefer it over unwrapping e.message.
        let persisted = ''
        try {
          persisted = sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_POPUP_DETAIL) || ''
          sessionStorage.removeItem(CACHE_STORAGE_KEYS.CMS_AUTH_POPUP_DETAIL)
        } catch {
          /* storage unavailable — fall back to the error message */
        }

        const detail =
          persisted || (e.message ? unwrapAuthMessage(e.message) : 'Failed to sign in with Google.')

        this.errorMsg = detail.includes(AUTH_STRINGS.APPCHECK_MARKER)
          ? 'Sign-in was rejected by the Firebase project — ' +
            'Authentication enforces App Check but this app sends no ' +
            'App Check token. Configure a reCAPTCHA site key ' +
            '(VITE_FIREBASE_APPCHECK_SITE_KEY) or relax App Check ' +
            'enforcement for Authentication in the Firebase console.'
          : e.code
            ? `${detail} (${e.code})`
            : detail
      }
    } finally {
      this.loading = false
      this._loginInProgress = false
      this._updateDom()
    }
  }

  /** JSX template for the login card. */

  override render() {
    return (
      <div className={CMS_ADMIN_CLASSES.ADMIN_LOGIN_WRAPPER}>
        <div className={CMS_ADMIN_CLASSES.ADMIN_LOGIN_CARD}>
          <h1 className={CMS_ADMIN_CLASSES.ADMIN_TITLE}>Luis Krötz CMS</h1>
          <p className={CMS_ADMIN_CLASSES.ADMIN_SUBTITLE}>
            Sign in to manage portfolio content, projects & translations
          </p>

          <button
            className={CMS_ADMIN_CLASSES.GOOGLE_AUTH_BTN}
            disabled={this.loading}
            type={FORM_ATTRS.BUTTON}
            onClick={() => this.handleGoogleLogin()}
          >
            <svg
              className={CMS_ADMIN_CLASSES.GOOGLE_ICON}
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              width="20"
              height="20"
            >
              <path
                fill="#4285F4"
                d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z"
              />
              <path
                fill="#34A853"
                d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z"
              />
              <path
                fill="#FBBC05"
                d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.06H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.94l2.85-2.22.81-.63z"
              />
              <path
                fill="#EA4335"
                d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.06l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.52 6.16-4.52z"
              />
            </svg>
            <span>{this.loading ? 'Signing in...' : 'Sign in with Google'}</span>
          </button>

          {this.errorMsg ? (
            <div className={CMS_ADMIN_CLASSES.ADMIN_ERROR_MSG}>{this.errorMsg}</div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
}

if (!customElements.get(CMS_TAGS.VIEW_ADMIN_LOGIN)) {
  customElements.define(CMS_TAGS.VIEW_ADMIN_LOGIN, ViewAdminLogin)
}
